caption.music.home_night.text: The hearth theme at night, sparse

ui.menu.refused.text: Not now: {count} hostile aware of you.

ui.menu.refused_many.text: Not now: {count} hostiles aware of you.

ui.system.motion_on.text: Reduced motion: on. Press {key} to change.

ui.system.motion_off.text: Reduced motion: off. Press {key} to change.

ui.shell.help.text: Keys: F1 to F6 orders, hold Tab for the order ring, M map, I inventory, B build, J report, Esc system menu. H toggles a test hostile. P next music, O stinger, K horn, L parry. F9 then a key rebinds Interact. T toggles hold-or-toggle for Run. Click once to start sound.

ui.shell.audio_locked.text: Sound starts on your first click or key.

c_hild.bark.call.01.text: Here! Over here, past the rocks!

c_hild.bark.call.02.text: I'm caught in the net! The water's coming in!

c_hild.bark.call.03.text: Over here! I'd come to you, but the net has other ideas.

c_hild.bark.found.01.text: {steerer}! The sea spat you out too. Get me up the beach before it changes its mind.

c_hild.bark.tide.01.text: Not here. The tide comes this far. Higher, up past the weed.

c_hild.bark.safe.01.text: That'll do. The sea's not having either of us today.

ui.naming.title.text: Who washed up on Wreck Strand?

ui.naming.hint.text: Enter to wake. A name can be left as Steerer.

ui.prompt.below_tide.text: The tide comes this far. Carry {name} up past the weed line.

ui.prompt.no_room.text: No room to set {name} down here.

caption.amb.strand.text: Wind and surf on the strand

ui.sound.intro.text: Every note and sound here is generated by the game as it plays: no recordings and no samples from anywhere else. Music changes land on the next bar line. Press any button to start sound.

ui.sound.layers.text: Layers (each switches on the next bar line):

ui.sound.hearth.text: The hearth theme (D Dorian, 6/8, about 36 seconds a pass)

ui.sound.voices_note.text: Lines stay as text; each speaker has a voice of short blips. The steerer has none.

soundtest.line.c_bran.text: I'll not leave him for the crows. Sit, if you're staying.

soundtest.line.c_runa.text: Hull's sound. The rest is rope and nerve, and I've plenty of both.

soundtest.line.c_oddi.text: It wasn't me! Well, it was. But I was going to put it back.

ui.sound.footsteps_note.text: Soft and low, never a sharp click, and no two steps the same. Each button walks six steps on one surface; the last walks four steps on each in turn, to compare them.

ui.shell.audio_on.text: Sound: generated by the game (Book 11 section 12).

ui.system.info_on.text: Information captions: on. Press {key} to change.

ui.system.info_off.text: Information captions: off. Press {key} to change.

ui.tip.seax.text: {use} strikes with the seax towards the cursor; hold {use} for a heavy blow. {parry} parries, {dodge} dodges, {shove} shoves.

ui.tip.seax.keys.text: {use} strikes with the seax the way you face; hold {use} for a heavy blow. {parry} parries, {dodge} dodges, {shove} shoves.

ui.tip.seax.pad.text: {use} strikes with the seax towards the right stick; hold {use} for a heavy blow. {parry} parries, {dodge} dodges, {shove} shoves.

ui.tip.bow.text: {slot} takes the bow in hand. Hold {use} to draw and aim with the mouse; let go to loose. You stand still while it is drawn: {cancel} lowers it.

ui.tip.bow.keys.text: {slot} takes the bow in hand. Hold {use} to draw; {move} turn the aim; let go to loose. You stand still while it is drawn: {cancel} lowers it.

ui.tip.bow.pad.text: {slot} takes the bow in hand. Hold {use} to draw and aim with the right stick; let go to loose. You stand still while it is drawn: {cancel} lowers it.

ui.tip.arrows.text: Arrows: {count} in the quiver. No arrows, no shot. {interact} on a spent arrow pulls it free; some break.

ui.help.empty.text: Nothing here yet. What you pick up explains itself, and is kept here.

caption.sfx.arrow_earth.text: An arrow thuds into the ground

ui.tip.line.text: {slot} takes the line in hand. {use} on water within reach casts it. Press {use} again as the line tightens for a better catch.

ui.tip.line.keys.text: {slot} takes the line in hand. Face the water and press {use} to cast. Press {use} again as the line tightens for a better catch.

ui.tip.line.pad.text: {slot} takes the line in hand. Point the right stick at water and press {use} to cast. Press {use} again as the line tightens.

ui.prompt.feed_fire_click.text: Right-click  Put driftwood on the fire

ui.prompt.need_wood.text: The fire needs driftwood: pick it up where it lies on the strand.

ui.work.result.fish.text: A fish landed: {count} in the stores

ui.work.result.nibble.text: Nothing yet. The line is out.

report.food.days.text: There is food for {days} days: {rd} rations in the camp.

report.food.one.text: There is food for one more day. Fish, or go short.

report.food.none.text: There is no food left in the camp.

report.food.fresh.text: Fresh fish makes up {fish} of it; eat that first, before it spoils.

report.fire.lit.text: The fire is still in, with fuel for about {hours} hours.

report.fire.out.text: The fire went out in the night. It needs driftwood to light again.

report.fire.none.text: There is no fire yet. Driftwood lies about the strand, below the broch.

report.wood.strand.text: Driftwood lies about the strand: {pieces} pieces of it.

report.wood.strand_one.text: One piece of driftwood lies on the strand.

report.wood.stack.text: There are {loads} loads of driftwood stacked by the fire.

report.shelter.none.text: The torn sail could be raised over the court as a roof.

report.shelter.done.text: The sail shelter keeps the rain off six.

report.wound.untended.text: {name}'s leg has not been tended. It will not mend until it is.

report.wound.tended.text: {name}'s leg is bound and mending. About {days} days more.

report.work.hild.text: {name} means to fish from the rocks below the path today.

report.slept.short.text: You slept badly and will feel it today.

report.slept.cold.text: The night was cold without a fire.

report.collapsed.night.text: You fell asleep where you stood, long after dark.

report.threats.none.text: Nothing has been seen on the water.

report.guard.tutorial.text: The salvage will feed you while you find your feet.

c_hild.bark.broch.01.text: There's an old broch up past the bank. Walls, at least. Come on.

c_hild.bark.broch.02.text: Keep up. My leg's worse than yours.

c_hild.bark.broch.03.text: Dry, near enough. We need a fire. Driftwood's along the weed line.

c_hild.bark.fire.01.text: That's better. Now see to this leg before it sets crooked.

c_hild.bark.tended.01.text: Tight. Good. You've done that before.

c_hild.bark.meal.01.text: Hot food. The sea can keep the rest of us.

c_hild.bark.fishing.01.text: I can't walk far, but I can fish. I'll be on the rocks below the path.

c_hild.bark.fish.01.text: There. Supper, if you can cook it.

c_hild.bark.shelter.01.text: A roof. Father's sail, keeping us dry. He'd laugh.

c_hild.bark.evening.01.text: Sleep when you can. I'll keep the fire in.

caption.sfx.task_cast.text: A line cast into the water

caption.sfx.task_catch.text: A fish splashing on the line

ui.play.zone.machair.text: The machair and the old broch

caption.music.island_explore.text: The Skarvholm theme, out on the island

ui.sound.home.life.text: The steading by time of day

caption.amb.home_dawn.text: Larks and oystercatchers at first light

caption.amb.home_day.text: Sheep and larks on the machair

caption.amb.home_night.text: A corncrake in the long grass

report.wood.one.text: There is one load of driftwood stacked by the fire.

p_steerer.talk.you_would.text: You would have done the same.

p_steerer.talk.heavy.text: You were heavier than you look.

p_steerer.talk.job.camp.text: Keep the camp: the fire and the pot.

p_steerer.talk.job.driftwood.text: Walk the weed line for driftwood.

p_steerer.talk.job.builder.text: Raise the shelter in the broch.

c_hild.greet.morning.01.text: Morning. The sea's still there. I checked.

c_hild.greet.day.01.text: Pull up a rock. They're biting, slowly.

c_hild.greet.day.02.text: You found me. Not hard, on this island.

c_hild.greet.evening.01.text: Sit. The fire's the only warm thing here.

c_hild.greet.evening.02.text: Eat with me. It's fish. It's always fish.

c_hild.greet.evening.03.text: Nothing out there. Same as yesterday.

c_hild.greet.night.01.text: Can't sleep either? Sit, then. Quietly.

c_hild.greet.wound.01.text: Mind the leg. It minds me enough.

c_hild.greet.warm.01.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd come by.

c_hild.greet.afraid.01.text: Steerer. Yes. What do you need?

c_hild.greet.devoted.01.text: Say the word. I'm already up.

c_hild.bark.work.01.text: One more. Then one more after that.

c_hild.bark.idle.02.text: Sing the one about the goat. No? Nobody?

c_hild.bark.weather.02.text: Long light coming. Too long to sleep.

c_hild.bark.grief.01.text: Don't. Not yet. I'll say when.

c_hild.warn.friendship.01.text: You could have asked me first.

c_hild.warn.friendship.02.text: I said nothing on the strand. I'm saying it now.

c_hild.warn.friendship.04.text: Put me ashore with kin somewhere. I'll not ask a share.

c_hild.warn.happiness.03.text: Not the rocks. Not in this. Ask me tomorrow.

c_hild.warn.happiness.04.text: There's work in Saltvik with a roof over it.

c_hild.warn.devoted.01.text: Where you go. Don't ask me twice.

c_hild.warn.rising.01.text: You came into the water for me. Father couldn't always say that.

c_hild.warn.rising.02.text: If it's the north channel, take me. I know it.

c_hild.warn.rising.03.text: I mended your cloak. Don't thank me. It was ugly.

c_hild.job.unable.01.text: I can't stand on it, let alone that.

c_hild.talk.wound.01.text: The leg's swelling. I've seen worse. On other people.

c_hild.talk.wound.02.text: Sitting down, I can fish. Walking, I can swear.

c_hild.talk.wound.03.text: It's knitting. A few more days and I'll run on it.

c_hild.talk.wound.04.text: Clean. You bind a good leg, Steerer.

c_hild.talk.job.01.text: What do you want of me?

c_hild.talk.season.spring.text: Spring gales. Good for drying sails and nothing else.

c_hild.talk.season.summer.text: Long days. The fish come in close.

c_hild.talk.season.autumn.text: Storms soon. The boat wants hauling up.

c_hild.talk.season.winter.text: Dark at noon. Keep the fire fed.

c_hild.talk.father.01.text: We've not found Father yet. Bran went after him, and Bran doesn't let go.

c_hild.talk.father.02.text: Loud. Fair. He'd have hated this broch. He'd have mended it.

c_hild.talk.rescue.01.text: You came into the water for me. I'll not forget it.

c_hild.talk.fire.01.text: First fire on this island. Feels like a claim.

c_hild.talk.shelter.01.text: A roof. Of a sort. Father would have laughed at it.

c_hild.talk.fish.01.text: Fish, and more fish. I'm not complaining. Yet.

c_hild.talk.oddi.01.text: Oddi was in the bow when we struck. If anyone floated, Oddi did.

c_oddi.greet.evening.01.text: Is there more? There's never more.

c_oddi.greet.meal.01.text: Don't stand over me while I eat.

c_oddi.bark.idle.01.text: How much is a share? Exactly how much?

c_oddi.bark.idle.02.text: I found it. Finding isn't stealing.

c_oddi.bark.work.01.text: Next time, give me the job nobody wants.

c_oddi.bark.wound.01.text: It's nothing. Fell off the wreck. Twice.

c_oddi.warn.friendship.01.text: You watch me like I'm a thief.

c_oddi.warn.friendship.02.text: I said nothing. I'm saying it now. I'm not a dog.

c_oddi.warn.friendship.03.text: Not that. Get someone you trust.

c_oddi.warn.friendship.04.text: Drop me at Saltvik. I'll find my own way.

c_oddi.warn.happiness.02.text: Three days of this. People talk.

c_oddi.warn.rising.01.text: You didn't have to keep me. You did.

c_oddi.warn.rising.02.text: Need something climbed? Ask me first.

c_oddi.warn.rising.03.text: I fixed your strap. Don't ask where the leather came from.

c_oddi.job.refuse.01.text: Not that. Get someone you trust.

c_oddi.talk.wound.01.text: It's nothing. Fell off the wreck. Twice.

c_oddi.talk.wound.02.text: With my hands, yes. With my legs, ask tomorrow.

c_oddi.talk.wound.03.text: Stiff. I'll be climbing in a day or two. Probably.

c_oddi.talk.job.01.text: Job? I'll do any job. What job?

c_oddi.talk.season.spring.text: Spring. Eggs on the cliffs soon. I can climb.

c_oddi.talk.season.autumn.text: Autumn. Everyone counting stores. Me too.

c_bran.greet.morning.01.text: Dia duit. God be with you. Eat first.

c_bran.greet.evening.01.text: Sit. There's broth, or there will be.

c_bran.greet.night.01.text: The night's long. Sit a while.

c_bran.greet.warm.01.text: Ah. Good. I'd hoped it was you.

c_bran.greet.cold.01.text: Say what you came to say.

c_bran.greet.devoted.01.text: I'll follow. God help us both.

c_bran.bark.idle.01.text: Eat first. Then decide who we are.

c_bran.bark.idle.02.text: Grace, then food. In that order.

c_bran.bark.work.01.text: Broth tonight, if the sea allows.

c_bran.bark.wound.01.text: A cut. I've had worse from a cooking knife.

c_bran.bark.weather.01.text: Quiet morning. A gift. Don't waste it.

c_bran.warn.friendship.01.text: You could have let that one go.

c_bran.warn.friendship.02.text: I said nothing at the time. I'm saying it now.

c_bran.warn.friendship.03.text: I will not do that. Find someone else.

c_bran.warn.friendship.04.text: Put me ashore. I'll not ask for a share.

c_bran.warn.happiness.02.text: Three nights without a fire. People notice.

c_bran.warn.happiness.04.text: There's work in Saltvik with a roof over it.

c_bran.warn.devoted.01.text: I'll follow. God help us both.

c_bran.warn.rising.01.text: You fed them first. Thorkel would have.

c_bran.warn.rising.02.text: If there's cooking, give it to me.

c_bran.warn.rising.03.text: I kept you a bowl back. Eat it while it's hot.

c_bran.job.refuse.01.text: No. Not that. Find someone else.

c_bran.job.unable.01.text: I can't stand to it. Not today.

c_bran.talk.wound.01.text: A cut. I've had worse from a cooking knife.

c_bran.talk.wound.02.text: I can stir a pot with one hand.

c_bran.talk.wound.03.text: Stitches are pulling. Three days, it'll be.

c_bran.talk.wound.04.text: Clean. Thank you. God sees it.

c_bran.talk.job.01.text: What would you have me do?

c_bran.talk.season.spring.text: Lent's over somewhere. Here we just go hungry.

c_bran.talk.season.summer.text: Long light. Good for drying fish.

c_bran.talk.season.autumn.text: Fill the stores now. Winter does not bargain.

c_bran.talk.season.winter.text: Winter. Broth every night, if I have my way.

c_runa.greet.morning.01.text: Tide's wrong for work. Work anyway.

c_runa.greet.evening.01.text: Sit there. Not on the chest.

c_runa.greet.devoted.01.text: Say the plank and I'll fit it.

c_runa.bark.idle.01.text: My chest. Then me. Then argue.

c_runa.bark.work.01.text: That plank will hold. I don't care what the sea thinks.

c_runa.bark.wound.01.text: Cut my hand on my own adze. Don't tell the sea.

c_runa.warn.friendship.01.text: You don't ask. You just do.

c_runa.warn.friendship.02.text: I kept quiet. Not any more.

c_runa.warn.friendship.03.text: Not that. Not with my hands.

c_runa.warn.friendship.04.text: Take me to Saltvik. My sister's there.

c_runa.warn.happiness.01.text: Wet tools, wet bed, wet everything.

c_runa.warn.happiness.02.text: Three nights cold. The wood's not all that's warping.

c_runa.warn.happiness.04.text: Saltvik has a dry naust and a roof.

c_runa.warn.devoted.01.text: Say the plank and I'll fit it.

c_runa.warn.rising.01.text: You kept the rites. Good. The sea noticed.

c_runa.warn.rising.02.text: If it's timber, take me. I'll know it.

c_runa.warn.rising.03.text: I've sharpened your knife. It was a disgrace.

c_runa.job.refuse.01.text: Not that. Not with my hands.

c_runa.job.unable.01.text: Can't hold an adze like this.

c_runa.talk.wound.01.text: Cut my hand on my own adze. Don't tell the sea.

c_runa.talk.wound.02.text: The other hand works. That's half a boatwright.

c_runa.talk.wound.03.text: It's closing. My hands work. That's what matters.

c_runa.talk.wound.04.text: Hm. Clean. You'd do for a shipwright's mate.

c_runa.talk.job.01.text: What needs building? Tell me it's a boat.

c_runa.talk.season.summer.text: Summer. Timber dries true now. Cut it.

c_runa.talk.season.autumn.text: Autumn. Boats up the beach before the gales.

ui.activity.work_half.text: {name}: {job}, at half pace for the wound

ui.activity.bed.text: {name}: in bed, too hurt to work

ui.reason.bed_bound.text: {name} is too badly hurt for that.

ui.reason.no_such_job.text: There is no such work here now.

report.work.half.text: {name} works at half pace for the wound.

report.theft.none.text: Nothing is missing from the stores.

c_hild.scene.theft.found.text: Steerer. Oddi's bedding. Salt fish, from the cask.

c_bran.scene.theft.found.text: Steerer. A word. There's fish in Oddi's blanket.

c_runa.scene.theft.found.text: Steerer. Look. Oddi's bed. Our fish.

c_oddi.scene.theft.excuse.text: I found it. Finding isn't stealing.

c_hild.scene.theft.witness.text: From the cask, Oddi. From us.

c_bran.scene.theft.witness.text: From your own, lad. That's the worst kind.

c_runa.scene.theft.witness.text: From the shared cask. You know what that's called.

p_steerer.scene.theft.fair.text: Put it back before everyone. Then you keep the tally.

c_oddi.scene.theft.fair.text: The tally. Me. Right. I'll count it twice.

c_hild.scene.theft.fair.text: Fair. Shame for a night, then work. Father's way.

c_bran.scene.theft.fair.text: Good. Give a thief a trust and watch what grows.

p_steerer.scene.theft.punish.text: Punish Oddi: the share goes to the store.

c_oddi.scene.theft.punish.text: My share. Fine. It's always my share.

c_hild.scene.theft.punish.text: Hard. But it was our fish.

c_bran.scene.theft.punish.text: Hard. I was harder at that age.

p_steerer.scene.theft.shame.text: Shame Oddi at the fire, before everyone.

c_hild.scene.theft.shame.text: That'll stay with Oddi a long while.

c_bran.scene.theft.shame.text: Shame breaks some. It made a thief of me once.

p_steerer.scene.theft.side.text: Finding isn't stealing. Oddi keeps it.

c_hild.scene.theft.side.text: From us, and you let it go. I'll remember that.

c_bran.scene.theft.side.text: Mercy. Or blindness. We'll see which.

report.trait.found.text: {name} shows a side not seen before: {trait}.

soundtest.line.resident.text: Steerer. The fire's lit, and the tide is turning. Will you eat?

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.alarm.01.text: Someone on the beach! Up, up!

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.alarm.02.text: Walk on, castaway. This wreck is ours.

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.taunt.01.text: The sea gave it up. We take it.

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.taunt.02.text: Come on, then. I have dug graves before.

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.hurt.01.text: You will pay for that cut.

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.plead.01.text: Enough! Take the wreck. Take all of it.

e_wrecker_svart.bark.alarm.01.text: Ketill! A stranger, coming this way!

e_wrecker_svart.bark.taunt.01.text: Plenty of room on that skerry for you.

e_wrecker_svart.bark.plead.01.text: I have done! I have done. Let me be.

e_wrecker_conn.bark.taunt.01.text: I have an arrow for you.

e_wrecker_conn.bark.hurt.01.text: I am hit! I am hit!

e_wrecker_conn.bark.plead.01.text: Do not! I will go. I will go!

e_wrecker_conn.bark.plead.02.text: It was only salvage. Let me go home.

e_wrecker_svart.bark.warn.02.text: This wreck is ours. Walk on.

e_wrecker_svart.bark.warn.03.text: One more step and you'll bleed.

e_wrecker_svart.bark.lost.01.text: Wind in the grass. That's all.

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.help.01.text: To me! Both of you, to me!

e_wrecker_conn.bark.runs.01.text: Not for a wreck. Not for this.

c_hild.bark.combat.danger.01.text: Men at the wreck, Steerer. Armed.

c_hild.bark.combat.downed.01.text: I am down. Get me to the fire.

c_hild.bark.combat.safe.01.text: The fire. Good. I will live.

caption.sfx.lunge.text: A scuff of feet, a breath drawn

ui.sound.sfx.tell_creak.text: Tell: a grunt and a creak

ui.sound.sfx.tell_steerer.text: The steerer's breath at a press

ui.sound.sfx.parry_rasp.text: A parry's wind-up: the guard coming up

ui.sound.sfx.block_creak.text: A shield raised: the grip creaking

ui.sound.sfx.whiff_scuff.text: A missed blow: the overbalanced scuff

caption.sfx.alert.text: A sharp breath, a blade drawn

caption.info.second_wind.text: Down. An ally can lift you

ui.gameover.line.text: The fight is lost. The household waits for word that will not come.

ui.system.second_wind_on.text: Second wind: on. Press {key} to change.

ui.system.second_wind_off.text: Second wind: off. Press {key} to change.

c_hild.search.tell.text: Three of ours are still out there. Oddi went into the water by the wreck. Bran had Father, up by the old mound, and Bran won't leave Father. And Runa went after a light last night, west along the cliffs.

c_oddi.search.call.text: Steerer! Here, by the wreck! The ship's silver is down there in the wash, in its strongbox. Leave it and the scavengers will have it. They've picked at the wreck all morning.

c_oddi.search.lifted_first.text: Me first? Then the silver's as good as theirs. Fine. Fine.

c_oddi.search.chest_saved.text: That's it, take it up. I'll keep. I'm not going anywhere.

c_oddi.search.safe_chest.text: The silver and me both. That's a good day's salvage.

c_oddi.search.safe_no_chest.text: Thanks for the carry. The ship's silver is gone, mind. The scavengers will have it by now.

caption.search.chest_lost.text: The strongbox is gone from the strand

c_bran.search.guard.text: Steerer. God be thanked. Three of them, after the chief's ring and sword. They'll not have Thorkel. Not while I stand.

p_steerer.search.bran.sneak.text: Come away quiet. Over the back wall, the two of us with him.

p_steerer.search.bran.fight.text: Stand with me. We'll see them off.

c_bran.search.joined.text: He's done. Help me take him home. He'll want a fire near him tonight.

c_bran.search.sneak_away.text: Over. Gently. Now walk, don't run.

c_bran.search.laid.text: There. Rest, chief. We'll see you sent off right.

e_wrecker_ketill.search.parley.text: That's near enough, empty hands and all. The old man's ring and sword, and we're gone.

p_steerer.search.ketill.silver.text: The ship's silver for Thorkel's body, and you go. Take it, or fight for it.

e_wrecker_ketill.search.silver.text: Silver. Now that's talking. Lads, we're done here.

p_steerer.search.ketill.threat.text: Leave him, or die on this grass.

e_wrecker_ketill.search.threat.text: Big words for empty hands. Have at them!

e_wrecker_ketill.search.go.text: Go, then. Come back when you've silver.

c_runa.search.found.text: Steerer! Stop there. Look at the stone. It's weeping, and nothing else up here is wet.

c_runa.search.light.text: A light, like a lamp in fog, along the cliffs. I went after it. Fool. It led me here, and the ground took my ankle.

c_runa.search.rule.text: The Cailleach rests here. While her stone weeps, nobody carries anything over the neck, and I'm not limping over it. Give her something that cost you. Or go round by the cliff path.

c_runa.search.chest_first.text: My chest. Then me. Then argue. Get it past the neck, out of the old woman's reach.

c_runa.search.tools_safe.text: That's my chest safe. Now me. Slowly.

c_runa.search.no_neck.text: Not that way. Not while she weeps. The cliff path.

c_runa.search.offered.text: She's taken it. Feel that? The wind's dropped. Now my chest.

c_runa.search.home.text: I'll get myself to your fire. Go on.

caption.search.stone_weeps.text: The stone weeps; the turf is dry

p_steerer.search.stone.confess.text: Say it to the stone: "I had the steering oar when she struck."

p_steerer.search.stone.seax.text: Lay the seax on the stone.

p_steerer.search.stone.bow.text: Lay Thorkel's bow on the stone.

caption.search.neck_gale.text: The neck's gale drives you back

caption.search.stone_dried.text: The stone dries; the wind drops

caption.tell.cailleach.text: Hail rattling on the standing stone

ui.prompt.offering.text: {key}  Leave an offering at the stone

ui.prompt.offering_click.text: Right-click  Leave an offering at the stone

report.search.cailleach.text: Runa says the Hag's stone was dry this morning. The Cailleach took what you gave her.

report.search.cailleach_unanswered.text: Runa says the Hag's stone was still weeping when you went round by the cliff path.

caption.amb.kelda.text: The spring bubbling into its stream

caption.amb.cairn.text: Sheep and larks about the cairn

e_wrecker_ketill.bark.parley.01.text: Hold there. Hands where I can see them.

p_steerer.talk.job.shipwright.text: Work on the boat with what we've laid by it.

info.boat.look.text: The coastal boat, drawn up under the bank: six oars, clinker-built, older than any of you

info.boat.lack_hull.text: Two strakes stove in below the waterline: it wants boards and rivets

info.boat.lack_rigging.text: No mast, no yard, no sail: the wreck on the skerry still holds its rigging

info.boat.lack_oar.text: No steering oar on its quarter: the scavengers' skiff in Seal Cave has one

info.boat.ready.text: Patched, rigged and steered: the boat would float

info.boat.fit_hold.text: Hides and lashings go up amidships: more room for cargo, a heavier pull at the oars

info.boat.fit_bow.text: A platform of wreck timber goes up at the bow: a place to fight from, less room aft

p_steerer.boat.fit_bow.text: Raise a fighting platform at the bow.

p_steerer.boat.unship_bow.text: Take the bow platform down again.

p_steerer.boat.carve.text: Runa, could you carve a new steering oar?

c_runa.repair.carve.text: From the wreck's yard. Two days, if nobody talks to me. Leave it with me.

c_runa.repair.carved.text: There. A steering oar. Ash would have been better. It'll do.

c_runa.repair.boards_laid.text: Good boards. The rivets will come out of them clean enough.

c_oddi.repair.rigging_laid.text: Half of this is knots. I like knots. Leave it with me.

c_hild.repair.oar_laid.text: Father's boat had an oar like that. Lash it on tight.

c_runa.repair.hull_done.text: The strakes are closed. She'll float. Don't look at the patch.

c_runa.repair.rigging_done.text: Mast's stepped. Stays are set up. Don't whistle near it.

c_hild.repair.oar_done.text: There's a steering oar on the boat now. Somebody has to hold it. That's you.

c_hild.repair.all_done.text: Patched, rigged, steered. Father would have hated this boat. That's how I know it's sound.

c_runa.repair.fitted.text: Fitted. If you want it off again, say so before I'm used to it.

caption.repair.rigging_cut.text: The rigging comes free of the wreck

caption.repair.oar_taken.text: The steering oar is yours to carry

e_wrecker_ketill.cave.open.text: You again. That's our skiff, and our oar. Say what you want or get off our beach.

e_wrecker_svart.cave.open.text: Ketill's not here to talk. I am. What do you want with our skiff?

e_wrecker_conn.cave.open.text: Don't. Please. There's only me. What do you want?

p_steerer.cave.silver.text: The ship's silver, for your steering oar.

p_steerer.cave.food.text: Three days of salt fish, for your steering oar.

e_wrecker_ketill.cave.silver.text: Silver. Now you talk sense. Take the oar. We'll row with a paddle.

e_wrecker_ketill.cave.food.text: Fish. We're hungry enough. Take it, then, and go.

e_wrecker_svart.cave.food.text: Fish will do. Take the thing.

e_wrecker_conn.cave.silver.text: Yes. Yes, take it. Just go.

e_wrecker_conn.cave.food.text: Fish? Yes. Take it. Thank you.

c_hild.rites.raise.text: Father's lain there long enough. Rites, before we sail. Talk to me when you're ready.

c_hild.rites.ask.text: Father's rites. A ship of stones on the machair, looking out to sea. Or the sea itself, with Father's ring for Rán, a gift to bring into Rán's hall. You choose. I'd give Father to the sea.

p_steerer.rites.setting.text: A ship of stones on the machair, where he can see the sea.

p_steerer.rites.sea.text: The sea, with his gold ring for Rán.

c_hild.rites.chose_setting.text: Stones, then. Bran will carry Father up. We'll set them this afternoon. Come when they're up.

c_hild.rites.chose_sea.text: The sea. Thank you. We'll take Father down to the shore. Come when we're there.

c_hild.rites.setting.text: He was the best steerer on the north coast. Now his ship is stone, and it won't sink.

c_bran.rites.setting.text: Christ keep him, and his own gods too, if they want him. I kept him as long as I could.

c_runa.rites.setting.text: Stem to the west, stern to the east. The stones are set right. He'll sail well.

c_oddi.rites.setting.text: He paid me fair. Every time. That's more than most.

c_hild.rites.sea.text: Here's your ring, Father. Give it to her yourself. Tell her we're not coming yet.

c_bran.rites.sea.text: The sea had him first. Christ keep him in it.

c_runa.rites.sea.text: Gold in his hand. Rán won't turn him from her door.

c_oddi.rites.sea.text: That ring would have fed us a month. Still. It's his.

caption.rites.stones.text: The stones of the ship-setting are up

ui.gate.launch.rites.sea.text: Given to the sea, his gold ring with him for Rán.

ui.gate.launch.rites.short.text: Thorkel has had no rites. Once the boat is launched, it is too late.

ui.launch.mark.like_ulf.text: Ulf Hrafnsson's raiders sail under a raven. The coast expects killing from a raven.

c_hild.launch.heave.text: Hands on the strakes. Together now. Heave!

c_bran.launch.afloat.text: Afloat. I'd have lost a wager on that.

c_hild.launch.named.text: {ship}. Father would have laughed at that. Then rowed.

c_runa.launch.sail.text: Sheet home. Let the wind have it.

c_oddi.launch.row.text: Out oars! Which end is the front again?

c_hild.launch.smoke.text: Smoke on the Irish shore. Where there's smoke, there's grain.

c_hild.launch.no_rites.text: We sail, and Father lies there with no rites.

c_bran.launch.drawn_up.text: Drawn up again, above the tide. It rows.

caption.launch.drawn_up.text: The boat drawn up above the tide

soundtest.line.survivor.text: Here! Over here, on the rock! Is that a boat?

caption.music.sea_calm.text: Oars, and a harp far off

caption.music.sea_wind.text: A flute over the rowing drum

caption.sfx.sail_strain.text: The sheets creak under the strain

caption.amb.sea_storm.text: A storm sea on the hull

ui.gate.launch.stores.one.text: Food for only one day in store.

c_hild.net.no_blade.text: The net, I can't get out of it. Find something sharp! Father's seax was in the stern.

c_hild.net.wave.text: That one went up my nose.

c_hild.net.cut.text: Oh, thank the gods. Thank you.

c_hild.net.joke.text: Next time, cut the net before the swim.

c_hild.chest.first.text: Father's chest. Get it up to the camp. He wore the key round his neck.

c_hild.camp.walk_up.text: Get the sail up between those oars, before the rain comes.

c_hild.camp.old_boat.text: Father would've had her floating by the next tide.

c_hild.fire.night.01.text: Sit. You've earned the warm side.

c_hild.fire.night.02.text: Bran will be with Father somewhere. Bran never lets go of anything.

c_hild.fire.night.03.text: He'd have hated being carried. He'd have hated all of it.

c_hild.fire.night.04.text: Still. A fire, a roof of sorts, and fish nobody's caught yet.

c_hild.fire.aims.01.text: Oddi was by the stern when she broke. Bran went after Father.

c_hild.fire.aims.02.text: And Runa will have gone after that light. Of course she has.

c_hild.chest.bow.text: That's his bow. He'd want it drawn, not mourned.

c_hild.mast.stores.text: That's our salt fish up the mast. An arrow through the rope would bring it down.

c_bran.search.key.text: His key. It was round his neck. It's yours to turn now.

c_thorkel.cold.shout.01.text: Hold her head to the sea! Hold her!

c_thorkel.cold.shout.02.text: Rocks! Rocks to starboard! Pull, all of you!

c_runa.chest.where.text: My chest. Where have you put it?

c_runa.chest.truth.text: Good. Off the wet ground, I hope.

c_runa.chest.lie.text: It's not where you said. Why say it, then?

caption.chest.key.text: A key turns in the lock

caption.chest.drag.text: A chest scraping up the shingle

caption.mast.stores.text: The stores, high on the mast

caption.ring.clink.text: A small clink from the pool

ui.journal.aim.find_hild.text: Find who is calling beyond the rocks.

ui.journal.aim.free_hild.text: Cut Hild free of the net.

ui.journal.aim.bring_hild.text: Carry Hild above the tide line.

ui.journal.aim.chest_to_camp.text: Carry Thorkel's chest up to the old tower on the bank.

ui.journal.aim.light_fire.text: Light a fire in the old tower.

ui.journal.aim.see_tower.text: Go up to the old tower to the north.

ui.journal.aim.shelter_frame.text: Stand the oars up and lash them for the shelter's frame.

ui.journal.aim.shelter_sail.text: Raise the sail over the frame, before the rain.

ui.journal.aim.scavengers.text: See who is at the stern.

ui.journal.aim.sit_fire.text: Sit with Hild by the fire.

ui.journal.aim.bring_oddi.text: Carry Oddi above the tide line.

ui.journal.aim.find_runa.text: Find Runa at the Hag's Seat.

ui.journal.aim.open_chest.text: Open Thorkel's chest with the key.

ui.journal.aim.stores.text: Shoot down the stores from the broken mast.

ui.journal.aim.hull.text: Patch the old boat's hull with the boards.

ui.journal.aim.rigging.text: Bring the rigging from the wreck at low water.

ui.journal.aim.rites.text: Give Thorkel his rites, if the household will.

ui.journal.aim.launch.text: Launch the boat when the tide is in.

c_hild.hint.find_hild.1.text: Over here! Past the rocks, to the west!

c_hild.hint.find_hild.2.text: West! Follow the shore round the rocks!

c_hild.hint.free_hild.1.text: Something sharp. A blade. Look in the wreckage.

c_hild.hint.free_hild.2.text: There was a glint on the shingle, back the way you came. Hurry.

c_hild.hint.bring_hild.1.text: Higher. The tide comes this far.

c_hild.hint.bring_hild.2.text: Up past the weed. The dry stones. There.

c_hild.hint.chest_to_camp.1.text: The old tower. Up the bank, past the stream.

c_hild.hint.chest_to_camp.2.text: Up the bank, then north. Set it down where the shelter goes.

c_hild.hint.light_fire.1.text: Wood! It's all along the tideline!

c_hild.hint.light_fire.2.text: Two good pieces will do. Then the flint.

c_hild.hint.hild_leg.1.text: My leg could use a look, when you've a moment.

c_hild.hint.hild_leg.2.text: Talk to me. I'll show you where it hurts.

c_hild.hint.scavengers.1.text: Someone's down at the stern. Hear that? Iron on wood.

c_hild.hint.scavengers.2.text: Take care. Folk who strip wrecks don't like to be watched.

c_hild.hint.sit_fire.1.text: Come and sit. It's been a long day.

c_oddi.hint.bring_oddi.1.text: Up past the weed with me, where it's dry. I'll limp the rest of the way.

c_oddi.hint.bring_oddi.2.text: Just get me above the tide line. This leg will get me home from there.

c_hild.hint.find_oddi.1.text: Oddi was by the stern. Try the west end, by the wreck.

c_hild.hint.find_oddi.2.text: West end of the strand. Listen for him.

c_hild.hint.find_bran.1.text: Bran went after Father. Up by the old mound, maybe.

c_hild.hint.find_bran.2.text: East, past the machair. The sheepfold under the mound.

c_hild.hint.find_runa.1.text: That light was out on the Hag's Seat. West.

c_hild.hint.find_runa.2.text: West, out along the headland. Mind the wind on the neck.

c_hild.hint.open_chest.1.text: You've the key. Father's chest is by the shelter.

c_hild.hint.open_chest.2.text: Go on. Open it. He'd want it opened.

c_hild.hint.stores.1.text: That's our salt fish up the mast. An arrow through the rope would bring it down.

c_bran.hint.stores.2.text: Stand still. Aim at the rope, not the bundle.

c_runa.hint.hull.1.text: The boards are on the shingle by the boat. Bring them.

c_runa.hint.hull.2.text: Boards by the boat, then work. I'll help.

c_runa.hint.rigging.1.text: The rigging's on the skerry. Low water, or you swim.

c_runa.hint.rigging.2.text: Wait for the ebb. Then out over the flats.

c_runa.hint.oar.1.text: The scavengers had a skiff. Seal Cave, north-east.

c_runa.hint.oar.2.text: Take theirs, buy theirs, or I carve one. Two days.

c_hild.hint.rites.1.text: Father should have his rites before we sail.

c_hild.hint.rites.2.text: Stones on the machair, or the sea. Talk to me.

c_runa.hint.launch.1.text: She's sound. Wait for the water and we'll run her down.

c_hild.hint.launch.2.text: Tide's in. Look the boat over and we'll go.

c_hild.hint.stores.2_alt.text: Stand still to loose. Aim at the rope, not the fish.

c_hild.hint.hull.1_alt.text: Runa would want boards. They're on the shingle by the boat.

c_hild.hint.hull.2_alt.text: Bring the boards to the boat and set to work.

c_hild.hint.rigging.1_alt.text: The rigging's fouled on the skerry. Low water, or you swim.

c_hild.hint.rigging.2_alt.text: Wait for the ebb, then walk out over the flats.

c_hild.hint.oar.1_alt.text: Whoever stripped the wreck came in a skiff. Seal Cave, north-east.

c_hild.hint.oar.2_alt.text: Take their oar, or buy it. Runa could carve one, given time.

c_hild.hint.launch.1_alt.text: She's sound enough. Wait for the water and we'll run her down.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.warn.02.text: Turn round. There's nothing here for you.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.warn.03.text: This is ours. Go back the way you came.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.warn.04.text: Leave it. You don't want this.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.taunt.02.text: Come on, then. The spear's long enough.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.taunt.03.text: You'll float back out on the tide.

e_wrecker_svart.sight.taunt.04.text: Two of us, and you half drowned.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.warn.02.text: Stay back. I've an arrow on the string.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.warn.03.text: We don't want trouble. Just go.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.warn.04.text: Please. Walk on. It's only salvage.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.taunt.01.text: I'll put one through your eye.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.taunt.02.text: Svart'll have you. Won't you, Svart?

e_wrecker_conn.sight.taunt.03.text: Run, and I'll not waste an arrow.

e_wrecker_conn.sight.taunt.04.text: Look at the state of you. Easy.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.warn.01.text: Get out of here. This is ours.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.warn.02.text: Walk away. I'll not say it twice.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.warn.03.text: Back the way you came, castaway.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.warn.04.text: Nothing on this hill for you but a grave.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.taunt.01.text: I'll gut you like a herring.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.taunt.02.text: Come here. I've dug graves before.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.taunt.03.text: The sea spat you out. I'll finish its work.

e_wrecker_ketill.sight.taunt.04.text: One more for the fold, then.

e_generic_norse.sight.warn.03.text: This ground's spoken for. Off it.

e_generic_norse.sight.warn.04.text: Nothing here worth bleeding for. Go home.

e_generic_norse.sight.warn.05.text: Leave now, and we'll forget your face.

e_generic_norse.sight.taunt.02.text: Good. I've not had a fight in days.

e_generic_norse.sight.taunt.03.text: Your bones will whiten on this shingle.

e_generic_norse.sight.taunt.04.text: Come on. Make it a tale worth telling.

e_generic_norse.sight.taunt.05.text: Odin's watching. Make it a good one.

e_generic_gael.sight.warn.02.text: Turn back. This is our ground.

e_generic_gael.sight.warn.03.text: Leave us be, and go in peace.

e_generic_gael.sight.warn.04.text: Not a step nearer. God sees you.

e_generic_gael.sight.taunt.02.text: The poets will laugh at how you died.

e_generic_gael.sight.taunt.05.text: Come and meet a Gael's spear.

p_steerer.spare.02.text: Go. Before I change my mind.

e_wrecker_ketill.spared.01.text: You'll be sorry for that, or you won't.

e_wrecker_ketill.spared.02.text: A life. I'll not forget whose.

e_generic_norse.spared.02.text: A life owed. I'll pay it, one way or another.

e_generic_norse.spared.03.text: The gods keep you. I'm gone.

e_generic_gael.spared.03.text: May you never need the like.

e_wrecker_svart.returned.favour.01.text: I'll stand out of this one. Call it square.

e_wrecker_svart.returned.ambush.01.text: Letting me go was a mistake.

e_wrecker_conn.returned.favour.01.text: The oar's in the skiff. Take it. I never saw you.

e_wrecker_ketill.returned.favour.01.text: You let me walk. I'll let you.

e_generic_norse.returned.favour.01.text: I owe you a life. Here's some of it.

e_generic_norse.returned.favour.02.text: Told you I'd pay. Now we're square.

e_generic_norse.returned.ambush.01.text: You let me go once. Not twice.

e_generic_norse.returned.ambush.02.text: Remember me? I've thought of nothing else.

e_generic_gael.returned.favour.01.text: God sent me back to you. Stand easy.

e_generic_gael.returned.favour.02.text: A life for a life. Take it.

e_generic_gael.returned.ambush.01.text: You shamed me before my own. No more.

e_generic_gael.returned.ambush.02.text: I prayed for you. Then I stopped.

e_wrecker_svart.teach.02.text: Only one ever did. Turned my own thrust aside.

c_bran.teach.svart.text: Svart's guard won't break. Turn the spear aside, then strike.

c_bran.teach.red.01.text: Not on the shield! Step out from under it!

c_bran.teach.red.02.text: That blow goes through wood. Get clear, then hit.

c_bran.teach.red.03.text: Wait for the swing. Then go in.

e_wrecker_ketill.teach.01.text: No shield ever stopped this one.

c_hild.open.broch.text: There's an old tower up on the bank, north of here. Go and see if it'll keep the wind off us.

c_hild.hint.see_tower.1.text: North. Up the bank, past the stream.

c_hild.hint.see_tower.2.text: The old round tower. You can see the top of it from the shingle.

c_hild.camp.frame.text: Oars first. Stand two up against the wall and lash them where they cross.

c_hild.camp.sail.text: Now the sail over the top. Lash it down tight, and stones on the foot.

c_hild.camp.shelter_night.text: We'll make it a proper one in the morning.

c_hild.camp.finish.text: The lashings stretched in the wet. Help me tighten them, then we'll turf the weather side.

c_hild.camp.finished.text: Now that's a shelter. Father would've slept the night through under that.

c_hild.hint.shelter_frame.1.text: Two oars up against the wall. Lash them where they cross.

c_hild.hint.shelter_frame.2.text: The third oar goes across the top. Then peg the ropes.

c_hild.hint.shelter_sail.1.text: The sail over the oars, before the rain.

c_hild.hint.shelter_sail.2.text: Lash it along the top, and weigh the foot down with stones.

c_hild.hint.shelter_finish.1.text: The shelter wants finishing. Come and lend a hand.

c_hild.hint.shelter_finish.2.text: Tighten the lashings, then turf on the weather side.

c_hild.dusk.sneak.text: Keep low in the dune grass. See them before they see you.

c_hild.rites.sea_taken.text: Gone. Rán has you now, Father. Be kind to her.

p_steerer.remark.thorkel.01.text: Thorkel. You brought us this far. I'll take them the rest of the way.

p_steerer.remark.thorkel.02.text: Cold as the sea that had you. Rest. We'll see you right.

p_steerer.remark.thorkel.03.text: You'd laugh at the boat we're patching. Then you'd show us how.

p_steerer.remark.fallen.01.text: All this for a wreck's leavings.

p_steerer.remark.fallen.03.text: Someone will wait for you, and wonder.

p_steerer.remark.fallen.04.text: The tide will have you before your friends do.

e_wrecker_conn.snatch.grab.text: Silver! Ketill can haggle for the dead. This is ours.

e_wrecker_conn.snatch.caught.text: Take it! Take the cursed box!

e_wrecker_svart.snatch.caught.text: Keep it. It's not worth a spear in the back.

e_wrecker_ketill.snatch.grab.text: Kind of you to mind it for us.

e_wrecker_ketill.snatch.caught.text: Have it, then. I'll have it back another day.

c_oddi.snatch.shout.text: Oi! Thief! That's the ship's silver!

c_oddi.snatch.safe.conn.text: That was Conn, the thin one with the bow. Our silver's gone up to the fold.

c_oddi.snatch.safe.svart.text: That was Svart, the spearman. Our silver's gone up to the fold.

c_oddi.snatch.safe.ketill.text: Ketill, that was, their leader. Our silver's gone up to the fold.

c_oddi.snatch.after.text: Never mind me! After the thief, before the dunes hide the silver!

c_oddi.search.safe_left.text: Thanks for the carry. The silver's still down in the wash. Fetch it up when you can.

c_oddi.snatch.safe.caught.text: You ran the thief down! Silver's in the sand. Don't leave it lying.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.stolen.1.text: Conn's brought us the ship's silver. So what's left to bargain with?

c_bran.fold.stolen.2.text: Then you've what you came for. Go, and leave him be.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.stolen_svart.1.text: Svart's brought us the ship's silver. So what's left to bargain with?

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.stolen_ketill.1.text: Their silver's in my lap now. So what's left to bargain with?

c_runa.remind.tools.01.text: My tool chest's still out on the headland. Bring it into the broch, would you?

c_runa.remind.tools.02.text: Those tools are all I have. Into the broch with them, out of the wet.

c_runa.remind.tools.03.text: The chest. My tools. The broch. I'll not ask again.

c_hild.fire.night.02_found.text: Bran brought Father home. Bran never lets go of anything.

c_hild.fire.aims.01_found.text: Oddi was by the stern when she broke.

c_hild.launch.no_rites_lost.text: We sail, and Father's out there somewhere, with no rites.

c_hild.talk.father.lost.text: They took him from the fold, the scavengers. He'll get no rites from us now.

c_hild.talk.father.found.text: Bran carried him home. I keep waiting for him to sit up and shout at us.

c_hild.talk.father.sea.text: Rán has him now. I hope the sea likes loud company.

c_hild.talk.father.stones.text: He's under the stones now, looking out to sea. Where he'd want to be.

c_hild.bark.shore.03.text: Loud, he was. The shore's too quiet without him.

caption.music.rites_sea.text: The rites, drums slow as the swell

caption.music.rites_stones.text: The rites, drums slow as a walk

c_bran.teach.svart_parry.text: Svart's thrusting! Meet it, turn it aside, then strike!

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.key.1.text: The key on his neck, Bran. Hand it over.

c_bran.fold.key.2.text: No. He's done. Leave him be.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.wound.1.text: Your leg's bleeding through. How long can you stand?

c_bran.fold.wound.2.text: Longer than you can wait, Ketill.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.silver.1.text: There was silver aboard. Bring us the box and keep your dead.

c_bran.fold.silver.2.text: The silver's not mine to give.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.posts.1.text: Conn's on the mound with his bow. Svart and I have the gate.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.gate.1.text: I've the gate, Bran. You'll not walk out past me.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.skiff.1.text: At dark we take the skiff round to the cave, with him or without.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.kin.1.text: Nobody's coming for you. They're all drowned.

c_bran.fold.kin.2.text: Not all. Thorkel's kin don't leave their dead.

e_wrecker_svart.fold.finish.1.text: Let me finish it, Ketill. One thrust.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.finish.2.text: And have his kin on us? Wait.

c_bran.fold.prayer.2.text: Christ keep him. Christ keep all of us.

e_wrecker_ketill.fold.ring.1.text: That ring's gold. Gold's no use to the dead.

c_bran.fold.ring.2.text: It's Thorkel's. It goes with him.

ui.prompt.teach_parry.text: {key}  Parry the spear as it comes
