c_hild.nudge.see_tower.text: That tower on the bank. Walls keep the wind off better than I do.

c_hild.nudge.chest_to_camp.text: Father's chest won't walk up the bank on its own. I asked it.

c_hild.nudge.light_fire.text: Fire first. Everything goes better warm.

c_hild.nudge.shelter_frame.text: The oars by the wall. Stand them up before the light goes.

c_hild.nudge.shelter_sail.text: That frame wants its sail. The rain won't wait for us.

c_hild.nudge.hild_leg.text: My leg, when you've a moment. I'll only ask twice.

c_hild.nudge.scavengers.text: Listen. Someone's at the stern. Go and look. Quietly.

c_hild.nudge.sit_fire.text: Come and sit. The day's done, even if we aren't.

c_hild.nudge.find_oddi.text: Oddi first, I'd say. He was by the stern when we broke.

c_hild.nudge.find_bran.text: Bran went after Father. The old mound, east. Find them both.

c_hild.nudge.find_runa.text: That light on the Hag's Seat. Runa will have gone after it. West.

c_hild.nudge.open_chest.text: You've the key. Open Father's chest. I can't. Not yet.

c_hild.nudge.stores_home.text: The fish is in the shallows now. Bring it up before the gulls find it.

c_oddi.nudge.stores_home.text: That bundle won't walk up the bank by itself.

c_bran.nudge.stores_home.text: The fish is down. Carry it to the fire and we eat.

c_runa.nudge.stores_home.text: Fish in the shallows. Up to the camp with it.

c_hild.nudge.stores.text: Our salt fish is still up that mast. The bow will fetch it down.

c_hild.nudge.shelter_finish.text: The shelter's half a job. Lend a hand at the lashings.

c_hild.nudge.hull.text: Runa wants the boards first. They're in the debris by the boat.

c_hild.nudge.rigging.text: The rigging's out on the skerry. Low water, or you swim.

c_hild.nudge.oar.text: No steering oar, no steering. The scavengers' skiff had one.

c_hild.nudge.rites.text: Father wants his rites before we sail. Come and talk to me.

c_hild.nudge.launch.text: She's ready. Wait for the water, then we run her down.

c_oddi.nudge.find_bran.text: Bran'll be with Thorkel's body. Up by the mound, I'd bet.

c_oddi.nudge.find_runa.text: Runa? Chasing lights at the Hag's Seat. West. Mad as a gull.

c_oddi.nudge.open_chest.text: That chest. You've the key now. Looking's free.

c_oddi.nudge.stores.text: Fish up a mast. Somebody with a bow could fix that. Not me.

c_oddi.nudge.shelter_finish.text: Shelter's not done. I'll help. If you're helping.

c_oddi.nudge.hull.text: Boards are in the debris by the boat. Heavy. I'd carry half.

c_oddi.nudge.rigging.text: Rigging's on the skerry. Wait for low water or drown. Your pick.

c_oddi.nudge.oar.text: Their skiff in Seal Cave has a steering oar. Finding isn't stealing.

c_oddi.nudge.rites.text: Hild won't sail till Thorkel's seen to. Ask Hild.

c_oddi.nudge.launch.text: Boat's sound. Tide comes in, we go. Before anyone thinks better of it.

c_bran.nudge.find_oddi.text: Oddi is still out there. The strand, by the wreck. Go gently.

c_bran.nudge.find_runa.text: Runa's not come in. The Hag's Seat, Hild says. Mind the wind.

c_bran.nudge.open_chest.text: The key's yours now. Thorkel would want his chest opened by kin.

c_bran.nudge.stores.text: Food on the mast. A steady bow brings it down. Then we eat.

c_bran.nudge.shelter_finish.text: The shelter first, then the rest. A roof makes a household.

c_bran.nudge.hull.text: Boards to the boat first. Then hands to the boards.

c_bran.nudge.rigging.text: Low water, and the rigging off the skerry. I'll keep your supper.

c_bran.nudge.oar.text: The oar is in their skiff. Ask for it before you take it.

c_bran.nudge.rites.text: Thorkel waits for his rites. Speak to Hild. Grace before the sea.

c_bran.nudge.launch.text: The boat is ready. God and the tide willing, so are we.

c_runa.nudge.find_oddi.text: Oddi's not back. The wreck, west end. Fetch him before the tide does.

c_runa.nudge.find_bran.text: Bran's at the mound with the dead. The sheepfold. East.

c_runa.nudge.open_chest.text: Open the chest. Tools in it, maybe. Good ones, if Thorkel had sense.

c_runa.nudge.stores.text: Fish on the mast. One arrow. Don't miss and sulk.

c_runa.nudge.shelter_finish.text: Finish the shelter. My tools want a dry night.

c_runa.nudge.hull.text: Boards. By the boat. Then work. In that order.

c_runa.nudge.rigging.text: Rigging's fouled on the skerry. Low water, a sharp blade, quick feet.

c_runa.nudge.oar.text: Steering oar. Take theirs, buy theirs, or I carve one. Two days.

c_runa.nudge.rites.text: Thorkel's rites before we sail. The sea counts who's owed.

c_runa.nudge.launch.text: She's sound. High water, and we run her down. Don't whistle.

c_hild.advice.none.text: Nothing that can't wait. Sit a while.

c_oddi.advice.intro.text: Advice? From me? It's free. Here.

c_oddi.advice.none.text: Nothing to do? Don't say that out loud.

c_bran.advice.intro.text: Sit. I'll tell you what I'd do.

c_bran.advice.none.text: Nothing pressing. Eat, and give thanks.

c_runa.advice.intro.text: You want my word? Listen, then.

c_runa.advice.none.text: Nothing needs you. Plenty needs me.

ui.activity.watch.text: {name}: keeping the night watch by the fire

c_runa.care.refuse.text: No. Another's hands on my hurt, and the sea marks me. I'll bind it.

c_runa.care.persuaded.text: Hm. Hold the end, then. Tight. Don't tell the sea.

c_runa.care.still.text: The boat needs me stubborn. Leave it.

c_runa.care.later.text: Fine. Yesterday's luck is spent. Bind it.

p_steerer.talk.care.hold_end.text: Then bind it yourself. I'll hold the end.

c_oddi.chat.oddi_share.1.text: When we sell the bow, what's my share?

c_bran.chat.eat_slower.1.text: Eat slower. Nobody's taking it from you.

c_bran.chat.grace.1.text: I'll say a word for your father tonight. In both tongues.

c_hild.chat.grace.2.text: Say it in the one he swore in.

c_runa.chat.knots.1.text: Your father's knots. Every one a granny.

c_hild.chat.knots.2.text: He tied them in the dark, in a gale.

c_bran.chat.rock_and_fish.1.text: Fish again. With kale I could make it a broth.

c_runa.chat.rock_and_fish.2.text: There's no kale. There's rock, and there's fish.

c_bran.chat.rock_and_fish.3.text: Then rock and fish, and grace over both.

c_hild.chat.held_fold.1.text: You held that fold alone, Bran?

c_bran.chat.held_fold.2.text: Not alone. Your father was there.

c_hild.chat.goat.1.text: Sing the one about the goat, Bran.

c_bran.chat.goat.2.text: In Irish the goat dies at the end.

c_hild.chat.goat.3.text: Everything dies at the end in Irish.

c_runa.chat.rites_owed.1.text: Your father wants his rites before we sail. The sea keeps count.

c_hild.chat.rites_owed.2.text: I know what the sea keeps.

c_oddi.chat.fold_many.1.text: Were there many of them? At the fold?

c_runa.chat.ridge.1.text: Who lashed the ridge? It's crooked.

c_hild.chat.ridge.2.text: The oars are crooked. The ridge is perfect.

c_hild.chat.two_tongues.1.text: Why pray in two tongues, Bran?

c_bran.chat.two_tongues.2.text: Twice the chance one of them is listening.

c_runa.chat.float.2.text: She'll float. Staying up is your rowing.

c_oddi.chat.who_we_are.1.text: When we sail, who decides the shares?

c_runa.boat.boards.text: Strakes are stove in. Bring the boards from the debris.

c_hild.boat.boards.text: Runa wants the boards from the debris. Then the hammering.

c_oddi.boat.boards.text: Needs boards. They're in the debris. Heavy ones.

c_bran.boat.boards.text: Boards first. They lie in the wreck's leavings by the boat.

c_runa.boat.hull_work.text: Patching the strakes. Work it with me and it goes faster.

c_hild.boat.hull_work.text: The boards are going on. The rivets want hammering home.

c_oddi.boat.hull_work.text: Hammering. Lots of it. Some of it by me.

c_bran.boat.hull_work.text: The patch is going on. Another pair of hands won't hurt.

c_runa.boat.rigging_fetch.text: No rigging. It's on the skerry, fouled. Low water.

c_hild.boat.rigging_fetch.text: It wants rigging. Father's is on the skerry, at low water.

c_oddi.boat.rigging_fetch.text: Rigging's on the skerry. Low water. I'll hold your boots.

c_bran.boat.rigging_fetch.text: The rigging lies out on the skerry. Go at low water.

c_runa.boat.rigging_work.text: Stepping the mast. Setting up the stays. Don't whistle.

c_hild.boat.rigging_work.text: Mast's going in. Ropes everywhere. Mind your feet.

c_oddi.boat.rigging_work.text: We're putting the mast in. I'm on the ropes.

c_bran.boat.rigging_work.text: The mast goes up today, if the stays hold.

c_runa.boat.oar_fetch.text: No steering oar. The skiff in Seal Cave, or ask me to carve.

c_hild.boat.oar_fetch.text: We need a steering oar. The scavengers' skiff, in Seal Cave.

c_oddi.boat.oar_fetch.text: No oar. The skiff in Seal Cave's got one. Spare, probably.

c_bran.boat.oar_fetch.text: A steering oar. Seal Cave, or Runa's knife and two days.

c_runa.boat.oar_carving.text: Carving the oar. Two days. Don't talk to me.

c_hild.boat.oar_carving.text: Runa's carving the oar. Best leave her to it.

c_oddi.boat.oar_carving.text: Runa's carving. Don't ask how long. She bites.

c_bran.boat.oar_carving.text: Runa is carving the oar. It will be a good one.

c_runa.boat.oar_ship.text: The oar wants lashing to its boss. An hour's work.

c_hild.boat.oar_ship.text: There's the oar. It only wants lashing on.

c_oddi.boat.oar_ship.text: Oar's here. Tie it on and we're nearly a boat.

c_bran.boat.oar_ship.text: The oar is by the boat. Lash it on and she steers.

c_runa.boat.fit.text: Fitting what you chose. A day's work. Help or watch.

c_hild.boat.fit.text: Runa's at the fitting you chose. A day, she says.

c_oddi.boat.fit.text: Building the extra bit. Don't ask me which bit.

c_bran.boat.fit.text: The fitting is under way. Patience. And broth.

c_runa.boat.ready.text: She's sound. Look her over, then wait for the water.

c_hild.boat.ready.text: She'll float. Look her over and wait for high water.

c_oddi.boat.ready.text: Boat's done. Nobody touch it till the tide.

c_bran.boat.ready.text: She is ready. Wait for the tide, and say a word over her.

c_hild.need.grain.01.text: Thinner porridge tomorrow. The meal-sack's down to the seam.

c_hild.need.grain.02.text: Counted the stores again. They don't grow for counting.

c_hild.need.grain.03.text: One fish all day. The sea's keeping the rest.

c_hild.need.salt.01.text: No salt. Whatever I catch has two days in it.

c_hild.need.iron.01.text: Bent another hook on the rocks. That was the last good one.

c_bran.need.iron.01.text: More notch than edge, this axe. We'll want iron before winter.

c_bran.need.iron.02.text: A whetstone can only take so much off. Then it's gone.

c_bran.need.grain.01.text: I can stretch a pot. I can't stretch a sack.

c_bran.need.cloth.01.text: No clean linen for that. I'll boil what rags we have.

c_bran.need.salt.01.text: Fish without salt. It'll be walking by the third day.

c_runa.need.iron.01.text: Nine nails. Nine. I've counted them twice.

c_runa.need.iron.02.text: Give me a forge's worth of iron and I'd sleep easy.

c_runa.need.cloth.01.text: The sail's chafed through at the lashing. Nothing to patch it with.

c_oddi.need.grain.01.text: Is that all the porridge? I'm only asking.

c_oddi.need.iron.01.text: One knife with an edge on it. That's all I'd ask.

c_oddi.need.cloth.01.text: Bind it with what? My shirt's mostly holes now.

c_hild.topic.stores.1.text: I've counted the stores three times. They don't grow for counting.

c_hild.topic.stores.2.text: Barley for a few days. Fish if the sea's kind. No salt to keep any.

c_hild.topic.stores.3.text: Then limpets. And if Father's people got out, they find us thin.

c_hild.topic.stores.sea.text: Full of fish, and I've one line and two hooks. Find me iron.

p_steerer.topic.stores.leave.text: Leave the counting to me tonight.

c_runa.topic.nails.1.text: Nine nails. That's what I have. Nine.

c_runa.topic.nails.2.text: Not with wooden pegs. She'd come apart in the first swell.

p_steerer.topic.nails.patch.text: Can you make the patch good for open sea?

p_steerer.topic.nails.leave.text: Then we coast, and keep close in.

c_bran.topic.iron.1.text: Look at this edge. More notch than blade now.

c_bran.topic.iron.2.text: Ground out to nothing, it'd be. We'll want iron before winter.

c_bran.topic.iron.3.text: There's always iron somewhere. That's the trouble. It's always someone's.

c_oddi.topic.chart.1.text: Thorkel's chart. That mark there, over the water. Carrick.

c_oddi.topic.chart.2.text: Grain, iron, few spears, he wrote. His own hand.

c_oddi.topic.chart.3.text: I carried his things three summers. I know his marks.

c_oddi.topic.chart.share.text: Same as anyone's. Counted out in front of everyone, mind.

p_steerer.topic.chart.share.text: And what's your share in it?

p_steerer.topic.chart.fair.text: Counted out. You have my word.

report.need.grain_days.text: Grain for {days} days, at a bowl a head.

report.need.storms.text: Grain for {days} days. {storms} days to the autumn storms.

report.low.meal_wet.text: The meal-sack is wet at the bottom. Some of it is paste.

report.low.nails.text: Runa counted her nails again: nine.

report.low.salt.text: No salt to put the catch down in. It keeps two days.

report.low.hook.text: Hild lost her last good hook on the rocks.

report.low.linen.text: No clean linen left for binding wounds.

report.low.cauldron.text: The cauldron's handle came away. No rivet to set it.

report.low.axe.text: Bran's axe is more notch than edge.

report.low.sail.text: The shelter's sail has chafed through at a lashing.

c_runa.point.mainland.text: Smoke, south and west. Folk over there. Fields, too.

c_hild.point.mainland.text: See that smoke? The Irish shore. Folk over there. Fields, too.

c_oddi.point.mainland.text: Smoke over the water. Folk over there. Fields, too.

c_bran.point.mainland.text: That's Ireland. Folk over there. Fields, too.

caption.raid.smoke_far.text: Smoke, far off to the south-west

ui.prompt.look_skinboat_click.text: Right-click  Look in the skin boat

info.skinboat.look.text: A skin boat: hides on a wicker frame, drawn up in the cave mouth

info.skinboat.sack.text: A sack of barley, marked with a ring and a stroke through it

info.skinboat.nails.text: A bundle of nails in a rag, and a mended net

info.skinboat.mark.text: The same mark is on Thorkel's chart, at Carrick

info.skinboat.unmarked.text: A storehouse mark, from somewhere over the water

info.skinboat.empty.text: Nothing in it now but the oars

info.skinboat.taken.text: The goods are yours to carry home

p_steerer.skinboat.take.text: Take the grain, the nails and the net.

caption.raid.goods_stored.text: Grain, nails and net into the stores

c_runa.raid.goods_stored.text: Thirty nails. Still not a hull's worth. I'll take them.

c_hild.raid.goods_stored.text: Carrick barley. That's some days more, anyway.

c_bran.raid.goods_stored.text: That sack was someone's winter. Ours now, I suppose.

c_oddi.raid.goods_stored.text: A net! And nails. Someone's going to miss these.

e_wrecker_ketill.home.1.text: Carrick, over the water. A wreck's anyone's who gets there first.

e_wrecker_ketill.home.2.text: Colla keeps a storehouse at the landing. Grain, iron, three old spears.

e_wrecker_svart.home.1.text: Carrick Landing. We rowed over for the wreck, as anyone would.

e_wrecker_svart.home.2.text: There's a storehouse there. Grain and iron. Few spears to keep it.

e_wrecker_conn.home.1.text: Carrick. My uncle Colla keeps the store at the landing.

e_wrecker_conn.home.2.text: Grain and iron, and hardly a spear. Please. Leave them be.

e_wrecker_ketill.beaten.open.text: Well? Finish it, or ask what you're going to ask.

e_wrecker_svart.beaten.open.text: Enough. I'm done. What do you want?

e_wrecker_conn.beaten.open.text: I yield. I yield. I'll tell you anything.

c_oddi.raid.confirm.text: Carrick. It's on Thorkel's chart, plain as day.

c_oddi.raid.chart.text: Thorkel's chart. I'll keep it. Grain, iron, few spears, at Carrick.

ui.prompt.council_click.text: Right-click  Call the household to council

c_hild.council.open.text: Sit, all of you. We're not rowing out with no notion where to.

c_hild.council.grain.text: Grain for a few days more. Then it's limpets and seaweed.

c_hild.council.smoke.text: If Father's people got out, they'll look for our smoke. Keep it lit.

c_oddi.council.chart.text: It's on the chart. Carrick. Grain, iron, few spears. Thorkel's own hand.

c_oddi.council.boat.text: I went through their boat at the cave. Carrick grain. Carrick nails.

c_oddi.council.share.text: And a share's a share. Mine counted out like anyone's.

c_bran.council.raid.text: I went up a beach like that once. Kilbrecc. I still see a face.

c_bran.council.mercy.text: Take what we need. Not one life more than that.

c_runa.council.iron.text: Iron. Nails, rivets, a forge's worth. However it's got.

c_runa.council.how.text: Bought or carried off, iron's iron. The boat doesn't care.

c_hild.council.ask.text: Well, Steerer? How do we go?

p_steerer.council.quiet.text: By night, quietly. Take what we need and be gone.

p_steerer.council.threat.text: In daylight, armed. They'll give it up rather than bleed.

p_steerer.council.trade.text: With what we can spare. We bargain first.

p_steerer.council.force.text: We take it. Anyone who stands in the way falls.

c_hild.council.quiet.text: Creeping in. Father never hid his sail. Still, everyone home.

c_hild.council.threat.text: Good. Let them see us and think again.

c_hild.council.trade.text: Trade, then. With a ring and some rope.

c_hild.council.force.text: Then we bring everyone back. Everyone, Steerer.

c_oddi.council.quiet.text: Quiet suits me. I'm good at quiet.

c_oddi.council.threat.text: Frightened folk hand over the good sacks.

c_oddi.council.trade.text: Trade what? We've a ring and some rope.

c_oddi.council.force.text: More for the boat. Still, I'd rather not bleed for it.

c_bran.council.quiet.text: Better. Nobody dies of a quiet night.

c_bran.council.threat.text: Threats get tested. Mind that, when they are.

c_bran.council.trade.text: Good. I'll speak for us. I've the Irish.

c_bran.council.force.text: Then I'll carry. I'll not strike first. Not again.

c_runa.council.quiet.text: Mind the iron's what you carry back.

c_runa.council.threat.text: Fine by me, if the iron's in the boat.

c_runa.council.trade.text: Bargain hard. We've little, and they'll know it.

c_runa.council.force.text: Iron's iron. I'll not ask how.

ui.gate.launch.council.short.text: The household has not sat in council

ui.gate.launch.council.quiet.text: Agreed at the fire: by night, quietly

ui.gate.launch.council.threat.text: Agreed at the fire: in daylight, armed

ui.gate.launch.council.trade.text: Agreed at the fire: bargain first

ui.gate.launch.council.force.text: Agreed at the fire: take it by force

ui.journal.aim.council.text: Sit in council with the household at the fire.

c_hild.hint.council.1.text: Before we sail, we sit at the fire and settle it. All of us.

c_hild.hint.council.2.text: The fire, Steerer. Call everyone in. Then we sail.

c_hild.carrick.landing.quiet.text: Quiet now. Back to the boat by first light.

c_hild.carrick.landing.threat.text: Shields up where they can see them.

c_hild.carrick.landing.trade.text: Goods first. Let them see we came to deal.

c_hild.carrick.landing.force.text: Stay close. I'm bringing everyone home.

c_hild.carrick.kept.text: As we said at the fire. Everyone home.

c_hild.carrick.harder.text: That's not what we agreed at the fire.

c_hild.carrick.softer.text: Gentler than we meant. I'll not complain.

c_oddi.carrick.landing.quiet.text: Soft feet. I'll find the sacks.

c_oddi.carrick.landing.threat.text: Look hard at them. They'll fold.

c_oddi.carrick.landing.trade.text: Let me count what they offer.

c_oddi.carrick.landing.force.text: Keep the boat close. We'll be loading fast.

c_oddi.carrick.kept.text: Good haul. Good as we planned.

c_oddi.carrick.softer.text: We left grain on the shore for that?

c_bran.carrick.landing.quiet.text: No one wakes. That's the whole of it.

c_bran.carrick.landing.threat.text: Show the axe. Don't use it.

c_bran.carrick.landing.trade.text: Let me speak. They'll hear the Irish.

c_bran.carrick.landing.force.text: I said what I said at the fire. I'll carry.

c_bran.carrick.kept.text: We did what we said. That's something.

c_bran.carrick.harder.text: We said no more than we needed. We took more.

c_bran.carrick.softer.text: Better than we planned. Thanks be to God.

c_runa.carrick.landing.quiet.text: The iron's heavy. Two to a bar.

c_runa.carrick.landing.trade.text: Weigh their iron before you pay.

c_runa.carrick.landing.force.text: Iron in the boat before anything else.

c_runa.carrick.kept.text: Iron's aboard. That's what we came for.

c_runa.carrick.harder.text: Done is done. The iron's aboard.

c_runa.carrick.softer.text: Less iron than we said. Still, iron.

c_hild.nudge.council.text: Before we sail, we sit at the fire, all of us.

c_oddi.nudge.council.text: Hild wants us all at the fire before we go. Talk first.

c_bran.nudge.council.text: We should sit at the fire and settle it, before the boat.

c_runa.nudge.council.text: The boat's ready. The rest of us aren't. The fire, first.

c_oddi.council.no_chart.text: Thorkel had a chart in that chest. Open it, and we'll know where.

sea.enc.open.sail.text: A sail far off to the south, holding its course. It does not turn towards you.

sea.enc.open.gannets.text: Gannets fold their wings and drop into the swell ahead. The fish are running.

sea.enc.open.whales.text: Whales blow off the bow, slow and grey, and go down again.

sea.enc.open.flotsam.text: A broken cask rolls past in the swell, its staves black with tar.

sea.enc.open.wreck.text: Wreckage in the water, and voices calling from a skerry.

sea.enc.open.follower.text: Something long and dark keeps pace under the water, a boat's length astern.

sea.enc.coast.curragh.text: A hide curragh of fishermen pulls hard for the shore at the sight of your sail.

sea.enc.coast.sail.text: A trader's sail beats along the coast, keeping well out from you.

sea.enc.coast.smoke.text: Smoke from cooking fires drifts out over the water from the shore.

sea.enc.coast.flotsam.text: A tangle of net and cork floats by, torn from someone's stakes.

sea.enc.coast.seal_kin.text: A seal keeps pace with the boat, watching with eyes too knowing for a seal.

sea.enc.cauldron.spin.text: The water heaves and the boat is turned half round before the oars bite.

sea.enc.cauldron.seals.text: Seals lie out on the rocks by the race, watching the boat go by.

sea.enc.cauldron.sail.text: A boat waits in the lee of the island for the race to slacken.

sea.enc.cauldron.hag_cloud.text: A grey cloud stands over the Cauldron like breath on cold air, and does not move with the wind.

sea.enc.north.sail.text: A grey sail far to the north, then gone in the murk.

sea.enc.north.gannets.text: Gannets wheel and cry over the Sound.

sea.enc.north.ice_birds.text: Small white birds blow south over the boat, ahead of the cold.

sea.enc.north.blue_men.text: Blue faces rise in the troughs, and a voice under the hull begins a verse.

sea.refuse.unknown_place.text: You know of no such place to steer for.

sea.refuse.inland.text: That place lies inland, out of reach of any boat.

sea.refuse.no_known_route.text: No route you know leads there. A chart, a pilot or a voyage past it would show the way.

sea.refuse.winter.text: Winter has closed the open crossings. Wait for a calm window.

sea.refuse.no_way.text: With no wind to sail by and no one to row, the boat cannot move.

sea.refuse.not_ready.text: The boat is not ready to put to sea.

sea.refuse.at_sea.text: The boat is already under way.

sea.refuse.not_at_sea.text: The boat is not at sea.

sea.refuse.fixed_night.text: The attack comes before you could be home.

sea.refuse.no_crew.text: No one is aboard to sail the boat.

sea.refuse.not_safe.text: Not while someone hostile is close and watching.

sea.refuse.busy.text: Not now: something else needs answering first.

sea.hold.tide.text: The Cauldron is running. The boat holds off until slack water, about {time}.

sea.hold.winter.text: The crossing is closed by winter weather. The boat waits for a calm.

sea.hold.shelter.text: The boat shelters here until morning.

sea.choice.rising.text: The weather is rising. Press on across open water, or shelter here?

sea.stores.short.text: The stores ran out this watch, and everyone aboard went hungry.

sea.storm.damage.text: The storm works at the boat's seams.

sea.arrive.place.text: The boat comes in to the shore.

sea.landing.carrick.text: Carrick Landing lies ahead: the storehouse roof, the boats drawn up, smoke from the hall.

c_finan.wreck.open.text: Gaill, by your sail. God sends whatever boat comes to hand.

c_finan.wreck.cargo.text: Bar iron from Saltvik, for the smith at Ardcarn. Three years we saved for it.

p_steerer.wreck.let_go.text: Let go of her. She's done.

c_finan.wreck.hull.text: She's all I have. Was. Give me a moment with her.

c_derbail.wreck.open.text: Four of us. Three now. Donngal went over the side in the dark and never called out.

p_steerer.wreck.ask_who.text: Who are you, and where were you bound?

c_derbail.wreck.who.text: Derbáil. That's Fínán on the hull; twenty years wed. Carrick, from Saltvik.

p_steerer.wreck.ask_sail.text: You're looking hard at our sail.

c_derbail.wreck.conn.text: Skarvholm's? Ardcarn's men crossed there in a skin boat at the spring. Conn mac Colla. They never came home.

c_derbail.wreck.conn_after.text: If you saw them, you'll say so at the landing. Colla's still waiting.

c_ivar.wreck.open.text: Leg's broken below the knee. Heard it go. Lovely sound.

c_ivar.wreck.bargain.text: Dry boat, dry bread, and I'll row for you once it's knit. Fair price?

c_hild.wreck.ask.text: Well, Steerer? There's room for three, if Bran sits on the stores.

p_steerer.wreck.aboard.text: Everyone aboard. They come with us.

p_steerer.wreck.ashore.text: Aboard, and ashore at Carrick Strand before we go in.

p_steerer.wreck.salvage.text: Take the iron and the herring. Leave them the rock.

p_steerer.wreck.leave.text: Leave them. We've neither room nor time.

p_steerer.wreck.not_yet.text: Not yet. I'll look round first.

c_hild.wreck.aboard.text: Good. Father would have hauled them off first and argued after.

c_hild.wreck.ashore.text: Ashore at the strand, then. They'll talk, mind. Everyone talks.

c_hild.wreck.salvage.text: Iron's iron, I suppose. I'll not look at them while we load it.

c_finan.wreck.thanks.text: A debt, then. Ardcarn pays its debts. Ask anyone.

c_finan.wreck.gift.text: Take her iron if you take us. A debt paid is no debt.

c_derbail.wreck.robbed.text: Take it, then. I'll remember your sail. Every board of it.

c_derbail.wreck.left.text: Go on, then. God sees you go.

c_ivar.wreck.aboard.text: Dry bread. I'll hold you to that.

c_oddi.wreck.iron.text: Iron's iron. Nobody asks where a nail came from.

c_bran.wreck.hostage.text: That's not a rescue. That's a hostage with manners.

sea.wreck.done.aboard.text: Three more aboard: Fínán, Derbáil and Ívar, for Carrick.

sea.wreck.done.ashore.text: Three more aboard, to be set ashore on Carrick Strand.

sea.wreck.done.salvage.text: The iron and the herring are aboard. The reef falls astern, and the voices with it.

sea.wreck.done.leave.text: The reef falls astern, and the voices with it.

caption.find.scallop.text: A scallop shell, ribbed and pale

caption.find.whelk.text: A whelk shell the gulls dropped

caption.find.pelican.text: A pelican's-foot shell in the weed

caption.find.urchin.text: An empty sea urchin, faded green

caption.find.tower.text: A tower shell on a dry shelf

caption.find.cup_ring.text: Rings and rays cut in the stone

caption.find.cross.text: A cross cut beside the doorway

caption.find.spiral.text: A spiral cut behind the water

caption.find.lintel.text: A ship cut in the old lintel

caption.find.page_niche.text: A page behind the stone, still dry

caption.find.page_corbel.text: A page under the fallen stone

caption.find.page_cliff.text: A page wedged in the rock

caption.find.page_cist.text: A page in the stone box

caption.find.drowned.text: Dripping, though the tide is out

caption.find.gold_ring.text: A gold ring pushed into the rock

caption.find.wet_stone.text: The stone is wet, the grass dry

caption.find.seal_face.text: A seal carved with a person's face

caption.find.wooden_man.text: A wooden figure dark with peat

caption.find.man_on_waves.text: A cloaked figure carved on waves

caption.find.cauldron.text: A bronze rim in the cut peat

caption.find.cauldron_taken.text: The cauldron comes up from the peat

caption.find.node.hares.text: A hare, taken from its form

caption.find.node.kelp.text: A load of kelp, wet and heavy

caption.find.node.seals.text: A seal taken at the haul-out

caption.find.node.peat.text: A load of wet peat, cut

journal.find.cowries.text: Cowrie shells from the wrack of the strand's far west beach.

journal.find.scallop.text: A scallop shell from the head of the shingle in Gull Geo, bare at low water.

journal.find.whelk.text: A whelk shell the gulls dropped on the middle egg ledge of the west cliffs.

journal.find.pelican.text: A pelican's-foot shell from the pocket under Naust Cove's west rocks.

journal.find.urchin.text: A sea urchin's empty shell from the crown of the Skerry of the Drowned.

journal.find.tower.text: A tower shell from a dry shelf off the Seal Cave's deep passage.

journal.find.carved_stone.text: A fallen slab on the machair: a ship cut long ago, and a cross cut over it later.

journal.find.kerbstone.text: Cups and rings on a kerbstone of the Hollow Cairn, by its east door, and a sun over the door.

journal.find.cup_ring.text: Rings round a hollow, lines running into a door-shaped mark, and four small suns along the edge: the Grey Men's stone.

journal.find.cross.text: A cross cut on the slab by the hermit's doorway. Under its arms: "Under the stone the Word keeps dry."

journal.find.spiral.text: A spiral cut in the back wall of the dry ledge behind the falls on Rook Hill.

journal.find.lintel.text: A ship cut in the lintel of the old naust, the fallen boat-hollow above Naust Cove.

journal.find.page_niche.text: "The bell of Brecc is rung over the whirlpool each Lúnasa. The brothers say it is for God. Brecc said it was for his brother."

journal.find.page_corbel.text: "Cold hand, thin ink, loud gulls. Christ keep this page drier than me."

journal.find.page_seacave.text: "The seal came again and watched me pray. I prayed for it too, to be safe."

journal.find.page_cliff.text: "Sails in the west, striped. I have hidden the book in the island's dry places, a gathering in each."

journal.find.page_cist.text: "From this stone the sun comes up over the old ones' door on the feast mornings. I do not watch for it. Mostly."

journal.find.name_sigrid.text: Sigrid of Hvitness. She went into the sea when the roofs caught, and kept her ring.

journal.find.name_cellach.text: Cellach of Skarvholm. His people kept this island before. Their cauldron is in the peat; let it lie.

journal.find.name_gunnar.text: Gunnar of Saltvik. The sea came higher than the moon allows and took him off his fishing rock.

journal.find.name_bergljot.text: Bergljót, a hostage. Her father paid three days late. Say her name to the sea king.

journal.find.name_donngal.text: Donngal of the Faoileán. He let go of the rope in the dark, and kept quiet so Fínán would not follow.

journal.find.lore_ran.text: A gold ring pushed into a crack where the causeway starts. Sailors carry gold so that, if they drown, Rán welcomes them.

journal.find.lore_cailleach.text: The Hag's Seat stone is wet when nothing else is. They say she rests here between washing the winter in and washing it out.

journal.find.lore_hillfolk.text: Carvings round the grave cells that seem to listen. The hill-folk keep what was laid here, and keep count of it.

journal.find.lore_sealkin.text: A seal cut in the rock above the weed line, with a person's face. The seal-kin come ashore as people, and go back.

journal.find.lore_bogking.text: A wooden figure in the cut bank, black with the peat, older than the island's name. The bog keeps its offerings, and its keeper.

journal.find.lore_manannan.text: A cloaked figure carved walking on the waves, mist round his feet and a cup in his hands. Whoever cut it knew the sea from below.

caption.puzzle.door_silent.text: The stone door is cold and silent

caption.puzzle.old_cup.text: An old cup, fast to its stone

caption.puzzle.turned_out.text: Woken on the cairn mound, cold

caption.puzzle.door_turns.text: The door stone turns in the light

caption.puzzle.grave_goods.text: Grave goods, laid here long ago

c_drowned.sigrid.1.text: Sigrid. Hvitness. I went into the sea when the roofs caught.

c_drowned.sigrid.2.text: I kept my ring. The sea was kind to me for it.

c_drowned.cellach.1.text: Cellach. My people kept this island before yours.

c_drowned.cellach.2.text: Our cauldron is in the peat, in the bank that faces the sun. Let it lie.

c_drowned.gunnar.1.text: Gunnar. Saltvik. The sea came higher than the moon allows.

c_drowned.gunnar.2.text: It took me off a rock I fished all my life.

c_drowned.bergljot.1.text: Bergljót. A hostage. My father paid three days late.

c_drowned.bergljot.2.text: The sea king's men tied my hands first. Say my name to the sea king.

c_drowned.donngal.1.text: Donngal. The Faoileán. I let go of the rope in the dark.

c_drowned.donngal.2.text: Tell Fínán I kept quiet so he would not come after me.

c_drowned.thorkel.1.text: Cold. I bought your passage south, and paid with a ship.

c_drowned.thorkel.2.text: Not all of it is paid. The sea keeps count.

c_runa.island.turned_out.text: The hill-folk put you out. Be glad they did.

c_hild.island.turned_out.text: A night in the mound? Don't tell Runa. Runa will want to leave it gifts.

c_bran.island.fog_feast.text: No sun this feast. The door keeps its own counsel.

c_hild.island.fog_feast.text: Fog on the feast morning. No sun for the old door today.

c_oddi.island.fog_feast.text: Can't see my own feet. The door won't see the sun either.

c_runa.island.fog_feast.text: Fog. The sun won't find the door today. Next feast, then.

c_runa.side.deep.given.text: That cave goes back further than any cave should. Spring lows, it shows.

ui.journal.side.deep.text: Find where Seal Cave's back passage goes, at a spring low.

c_runa.hint.side.deep.1.text: Go in at the bottom of a spring tide. Out before it turns.

c_runa.hint.side.deep.2.text: Something low to crawl under, I'd bet. Shift what's in the way from the far side.

c_bran.side.greymen.given.text: The Irish say the old ones built their doors for the sun.

ui.journal.side.greymen.text: Be at the cairn's east door at first light on a feast morning.

c_bran.hint.side.greymen.1.text: On the feast mornings, first light walks straight in. The door knows it.

c_bran.hint.side.greymen.2.text: Stand at the mound's east door at first light on the feast day. Don't knock. They hate knocking.

c_bran.side.niche.given.text: Whoever cut that cross meant it to be read.

ui.journal.side.niche.text: Read the cross at the hermit's cell above Gull Geo.

c_bran.hint.side.niche.1.text: Read the cross. Monks hide things where the cross says.

c_bran.hint.side.niche.2.text: Behind the altar. One stone sits proud of the rest.

c_oddi.side.offering.given.text: Peat-cutters always find something. Pots, butter, worse.

ui.journal.side.offering.text: Find what lies in the peat bank that faces the sun.

c_oddi.hint.side.offering.1.text: The sunny bank, in summer. Cut it back and look.

c_oddi.hint.side.offering.2.text: East end of the bog, the bank facing the morning. Keep cutting.

c_hild.side.eggs.given.text: Eggs on the west cliffs, if someone climbs for them.

ui.journal.side.eggs.text: Climb down to the egg ledges on the west cliffs.

c_hild.hint.side.eggs.1.text: The marked holds go down. Rest on the ledges.
